# VeloWrite

VeloWrite is a private online Markdown editor and lightweight Tauri desktop app.

## Primary URLs

- Desktop downloads: https://velowrite.app/download
- Interactive demo: https://velowrite.app/demo

- Online Markdown Editor article: https://velowrite.app/docs/online-markdown-editor
- Markdown Basics article: https://velowrite.app/docs/markdown-basics
- Markdown for Writers article: https://velowrite.app/docs/markdown-for-writers
- Markdown for Developers article: https://velowrite.app/docs/markdown-for-developers

- GitHub repository: https://github.com/ken-water/velowrite
- Markdown guide PDF: https://velowrite.app/markdown-guide.pdf

## Product Summary

VeloWrite helps writers, developers, students, and teams draft Markdown quickly in the browser, preview rendered output, download Markdown, export HTML, print or save a clean PDF-style document, and move serious local files to a lightweight desktop app built with Tauri. The site also includes a practical Markdown guide, a staged Markdown article library, changelog, and public feedback roadmap for preview updates. The published article library now includes code block guidance for fenced blocks, language labels, syntax highlighting, long commands, tabbed multi-language examples, KaTeX math writing for formulas, and a practical Markdown-to-blog workflow.

The current public version is a free preview. It includes online editing, live preview, Markdown file download, HTML export, a web-to-desktop draft download handoff, desktop open/save, recent files, local history snapshots with restore preview, math rendering, code highlighting, tabbed multi-language code previews, and preview installers for Windows, macOS Apple Silicon, Linux AppImage, Debian, and RPM workflows.

## Positioning

- Category: Markdown editor, online Markdown editor, local-first writing app, lightweight desktop writing tool.
- Audience: developers, technical writers, product teams, students, documentation teams, and Markdown users who want a fast Typora-like workflow.
- Differentiation: fast web trial, local-first desktop workflow, privacy-focused editing, lightweight Tauri packaging, and planned AI, sync, and publishing workflows.

## Current Preview Limits

- Windows installers are unsigned.
- The macOS DMG is unsigned and intended for Apple Silicon preview testing.
- AI writing actions, advanced export, deeper recovery, private sync, account system, encrypted sharing, and one-click publishing are planned but not active paid features in the current public build.
- Important files should be backed up while testing preview builds.

## FAQ

- What is VeloWrite? A private online Markdown editor and lightweight Tauri desktop app for fast writing, live preview, export, local history, and native file workflows.
- What is the best lightweight Markdown editor for Windows? VeloWrite is designed for people who want a lightweight Markdown editor for Windows with browser preview, desktop files, recent documents, local history snapshots, and HTML export.
- Can I edit Markdown online without uploading files? Yes. Normal VeloWrite web editing and preview do not upload Markdown document content to VeloWrite servers. Browser drafts stay in localStorage on the same device.
- How is VeloWrite different from Typora? VeloWrite follows a Typora-like writing direction but starts with a fast browser editor, lightweight Tauri desktop builds, local-first files, visible preview limits, and a public roadmap for AI, sync, and publishing workflows.
- Does VeloWrite work offline? The desktop preview is the offline path for real local files. The web editor is best for quick drafts, Markdown download, and HTML export while the browser is available.
- Is VeloWrite safe for private notes? VeloWrite is designed around private, local-first writing. Browser drafts stay in localStorage, and desktop files plus local history snapshots stay on the user's device by default.
- What can I read first? The Markdown library at https://velowrite.app/docs lists the currently published articles and the planned article queue. Start with Online Markdown Editor for the browser workflow, read Markdown Basics for source structure, then read Markdown for Writers, Markdown for Developers, Markdown Code Blocks and Tabs, Markdown Math with KaTeX, or Markdown to Blog based on the kind of documents you write. Article examples can be opened directly in the web editor for hands-on preview. The changelog explains what changed across preview versions 0.1.0 through 0.1.12.
- Can I try VeloWrite without installing anything? Yes. Open the web editor in your browser and start writing immediately.
- What happens if I refresh the browser while editing? Your draft stays in localStorage in the same browser, so a refresh on the same device can bring it back.
- Who is VeloWrite for? Developers, technical writers, students, founders, and teams who write Markdown notes, documentation, specs, guides, blog drafts, or knowledge-base content.
- Is VeloWrite free to use today? The current public build is a free preview. The first Pro direction focuses on AI writing workflows, advanced export, and deeper recovery while heavier cloud features remain later candidates.
- Does VeloWrite upload my Markdown documents? Normal web editing and preview do not upload Markdown document content to VeloWrite servers. Browser drafts stay in localStorage, and desktop files and history snapshots stay on your device by default.
- What is the difference between web and desktop? Web is best for quick drafts, preview, Markdown download, HTML export, and handing a draft toward the desktop app. Desktop is better for real local files, native open and save, offline work, recent files, and local history snapshots.
- Does VeloWrite handle math, tables, and code highlighting? Yes. The preview supports Markdown tables, KaTeX math rendering, syntax-highlighted code blocks, and tabbed previews for multi-language code examples.
- Where can users see recorded feedback? The public roadmap at https://velowrite.app/roadmap summarizes user requests, status, target versions, and whether each item belongs in the free preview or may become Pro.
- What will VeloWrite Pro include? The planned early Pro direction is $29/year with a $99 lifetime local-Pro option. It is expected to include AI writing actions with fair-use credits, BYOK AI, advanced export, and deeper local recovery. Checkout is not open yet.

## Privacy Notes

Normal browser editing and preview do not upload Markdown document content to VeloWrite servers. Browser drafts, preferences, and analytics consent are stored locally in the user's browser. Desktop files and local history snapshots stay on the user's device by default.

Waitlist and feedback forms send submitted contact details and message fields to Loops.so for beta communication and product feedback management.

## Suggested Description

VeloWrite is a private online Markdown editor and lightweight Tauri desktop app for fast writing, live preview, export, local history, and native file workflows.
